steps.label: Precondition: no contacts before the cue ball reaches the rack
Precondition: cue ball (body 1) starts at rest height y=0.5
Cue ball crosses the table and strikes the rack (~0.5s)

Change: the strike produced contacts (this dispatcher exposes no X/Z getters, so the collision's horizontal momentum transfer is only observable indirectly via contact events -- see docs/todo/PLAN_physics_scenario_test_rebuild.md)
Let the balls continue to interact (~0.5s more)
Invariant: cue ball stays at table height (didn't launch into the air)
Invariant: a rack ball (body 4) stays at table height too
